item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed the Office of the Auditor General's response to a recommendation about secure retention of audit information.
item.support: This report reviews the response of the OAG to the recommendation in that report.

item.text: The review examined changes to data storage, staff instructions, portable storage devices and checks on compliance.
item.support: The OAG continues to take steps to improve its overall data management.

item.text: The Commission concluded that procedures and staff awareness had improved and that the recommendation was complete.
item.support: The Commission considers this recommendation to be complete.

item.quote: The Commission considers this recommendation to be complete.
